'''Ira Myers''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam]] on 4 March 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops]] and Harvest-ish, according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d314">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-06-stitches-florida-gs-p1-march-400d314/ stitches-florida-gs-p1-march-400], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 6 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-06-stitches-florida-gs-p1-march-400d314/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
